questions.question: At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.

questions.question: At which ground did Zintle Kula record their career-best innings (50, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Lions on 2024/10/05.

questions.question: How many wicketkeeping dismissals separate the all-time #1 (Trisha Chetty) and #2 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) wicketkeepers (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Trisha Chetty: 113 — Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 111 — a gap of 2.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Dragons or Titans?
At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Uplands College — largest win by runs of 218, against Rhinos on 2025/03/01.
